[2026-09-21] rc:4061846509 inline on src/util/threadnames.cpp by hodlinator (member) (edited 2026-09-21):
One could potentially retain the `HAVE_SETTHREADDESCRIPTION` logic and make it fail at compile time:

```c++
#if defined(WIN32) && !defined(HAVE_SETTHREADDESCRIPTION)
#error "At least Mingw-w64 version 12.0 is required."
#endif
```

But I'm okay with just documenting the minimum version as well, and dropping `HAVE_SETTHREADDESCRIPTION` to keep build complexity down.

---

Completed Linux->Windows cross CI locally:

```
env -i HOME="$HOME" PATH="$PATH" USER="$USER" bash -c 'MAKEJOBS="-j$(nproc)" FILE_ENV="./ci/test/00_setup_env_win64.sh" ./ci/test_run_all.sh'
```

(test_run_all.sh calls 02_run_container.py which calls shell-win64-cross.nix since 00_setup_env_win64.sh set `HOST=x86_64-w64-mingw32ucrt`).
